original_card.question: Does one explicit extension of the connector alphabet offer a favorable completed budget?
methods: Construct and charge a legal extra operation on a minimal instance.
Prove a target-specific bound after adding one specified operation family.
original_card.acceptance_gate: State which fixed-alphabet premise changes and charge its implementation; do not declare it free. A scoped local result may be retained without a complete supplier. Expanding it into further construction rounds requires the family-level budget and obligation gate in research-family-status.md; an optimistic passing relaxation alone is not acceptance.

first_step.scope: Positive control / source-bound orientation only; this is not a new construction or full cold replay.

original_card.first_experiment: Add exactly one legally priced operation and test a tiny dirty-input instance before enumerating larger cases.
original_card.bottleneck_link: A new legal connector operation could change recursive interface cost; a larger census in the same alphabet is a separate side result.
allowed_variations: Choose one additional operation and a small source count for its first counterexample.
scope_change_triggers: Keeping the alphabet and only increasing the source count; record this as a changed assignment.
Extending a source-count census without naming a supplier/interface decision it could change; audit #2973 pruning concerns before relying on the affected predecessor exclusions.

actual_scope: Exact right-vector paid cost for invertible two-role targets over F2[t]; cost four for (UL)^2 and unbounded cost 2k for (UL)^k.
scope_change_reason: The connector card is changed to the all-algebra three-factor question explicitly left open by #4276. The non-semilocal polynomial coefficient algebra changes the semilocal premise of #4749. This is a formal-alphabet side result, not an extension of the source-toggle census.
bottleneck_link: A scoped obstruction to a universal three-factor abstraction. The result gives no native implementation or multiplication saving.
stop_rule: Package the first exact cost-four target, its reduced-word lower bound and direct corollary; do not search larger examples.
evidence: PROOF.md gives a self-contained quantified degree proof. verify.py enumerates all 1536 invertible polynomial matrices of maximum entry degree at most four, with cost histogram [6,270,612,504,144], checks 96 literal invertible paid parameter tuples and seven negative controls, and emits a generated file-bound receipt.
author: Nick Petalas
ai_assistance: Independent human and formal proof-kernel review are unclaimed.

open_questions.question: What is the exact right-vector cost over a multivariate polynomial algebra such as F2[s,t]?
open_questions.why_it_matters: The one-variable degree normal form and Euclidean reachability do not supply a classification there.
open_questions.first_step: Specify one reachable word whose two variable directions cannot be collapsed by the single-variable argument; separate reachability from lower bounds.
open_questions.blocked_by: No multivariate normal-form or reachability theorem is supplied here.

open_questions.question: Which finitely generated coefficient algebras occurring in a literal native interface preserve a bounded two-role cost?
open_questions.why_it_matters: The abstract alphabet can have unbounded cost, while the semilocal theorem gives a three-factor bound.
open_questions.first_step: Identify one actual coefficient algebra and price polynomial left-coefficient preparation, conversion and the complete consumer.
open_questions.blocked_by: Native preparation, conversion, routing, precision, restoration and stock costs are unknown.
